devanagari: वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभ। निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा॥ गजाननं भूतगणादिसेवितं कपित्थजम्बूफलचारुभक्षणम्। उमासुतं शोकविनाशकारकं नमामि विघ्नेश्वरपादपङ्कजम्॥
phonetic: Vakratunda Mahakaya Surya Koti Samaprabha, Nirvighnam Kuru Me Deva Sarva Karyeshu Sarvada. Gajananam Bhuta Ganadi Sevitam, Kapittha Jambu Phala Charu Bhakshanam. Umasutam Shoka Vinasha Karakam, Namami Vighneshwara Pada Pankajam.
english_text: O Lord Ganesha, of large body and curved trunk, with the brilliance of a million suns, please make all my works free of obstacles always. I bow to the lotus feet of Ganesha, who is served by all beings, who delightfully eats the kapittha and jambu fruits, the son of Uma, and the destroyer of sorrows.
benefits: Obstacle removal and successful beginnings

devanagari: गुरुर्ब्रह्मा गुरुर्विष्णुर्गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः। गुरुः साक्षात् परब्रह्म तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः॥ अखण्डमण्डलाकारं व्याप्तं येन चराचरम्। तत्पदं दर्शितं येन तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः॥
phonetic: Gurur Brahma Gurur Vishnu Gurur Devo Maheshwarah, Guruh Sakshat Parabrahma Tasmai Shri Gurave Namaha. Akhanda Mandalalakarum Vyaptam Yena Characharam, Tatpadam Darshitam Yena Tasmai Shri Gurave Namaha.
english_text: The Guru is Brahma, the Guru is Vishnu, the Guru is Lord Shiva. The Guru is verily the Supreme Absolute; salutations to that revered Guru. Salutations to the Guru who has revealed the Supreme Truth, which pervades the entire unbroken cosmic manifestation of moving and unmoving beings.
benefits: Wisdom, spiritual guidance, and clarity

devanagari: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि। धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥ ॐ सह नाववतु। सह नौ भुनक्तु। सह वीर्यं करवावहै। तेजस्वि नावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै। ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥
phonetic: Om Bhur Bhuvah Svaha Tat Savitur Varenyam Bhargo Devasya Dhimahi, Dhiyo Yo Nah Prachodayat. Om Saha Navavatu, Saha Nau Bhunaktu, Saha Viryam Karavavahai. Tejasvi Navadhitam Astu Ma Vidvishavahai. Om Shantih Shantih Shantih.
english_text: We meditate on the adorable glory of the radiant Supreme Creator; may He inspire and illuminate our intellect. May the Divine protect us both (teacher and student), may He nourish us, may we work together with great energy. May our study be enlightening and fruitful, and may we never hate each other. Om Peace, Peace, Peace.
benefits: Intellectual awakening and harmonious learning

devanagari: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्। उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात्॥ कर्पूरगौरं करुणावतारं संसारसारं भुजगेन्द्रहारम्। सदा वसन्तं हृदयारविन्दे भवं भवानीसहितं नमामि॥
phonetic: Om Tryambakam Yajamahe Sugandhim Pushtivardhanam, Urvarukamiva Bandhanan Mrityor Mukshiya Maamritat. Karpura Gauram Karunavataram Samsara Saram Bhujagendra Haram, Sada Vasantam Hridayaravinde Bhavam Bhavani Sahitam Namami.
english_text: We worship the Three-Eyed Lord Shiva, who is fragrant and nourishes all beings. May He liberate us from death for the sake of immortality, just as a ripe cucumber effortlessly separates from its vine. I bow to Lord Shiva, who is pure as camphor, the incarnation of compassion, the essence of the world, adorned with a serpent garland, always residing in the lotus of the heart alongside Goddess Bhavani.
benefits: Health, longevity, and liberation from fear

devanagari: या कुन्देन्दुतुषारहारधवला या शुभ्रवस्त्रावृता या वीणावरदण्डमण्डितकरा या श्वेतपद्मासना। या ब्रह्माच्युतशंकरप्रभृतिभिर्देवैः सदा वन्दिता सा मां पातु सरस्वती भगवती निःशेषजाड्यापहा॥
phonetic: Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala Ya Shubhra Vastravrita, Ya Vina Varadanda Manditakara Ya Shveta Padmasana. Ya Brahmachyuta Shankara Prabhritibhir Devaih Sada Vandita, Sa Mam Patu Saraswati Bhagavati Nihshesha Jadyapaha.
english_text: May Goddess Saraswati protect me; She who is fair like the jasmine flower, the moon, and frost; She who is adorned in pure white garments; whose hands are adorned with the divine Vina; who sits on a white lotus; who is constantly praised by Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva; and who completely destroys all ignorance and sluggishness.
benefits: Knowledge, creativity, and removal of ignorance

devanagari: ॐ सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः। सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत्॥ असतो मा सद्गमय। तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय। मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय। ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥
phonetic: Om Sarve Bhavantu Sukhinah Sarve Santu Niramayah, Sarve Bhadrani Pashyantu Ma Kashchid Duhkha Bhag Bhavet. Asato Ma Sadgamaya, Tamaso Ma Jyotir Gamaya, Mrityor Ma Amritam Gamaya. Om Shantih Shantih Shantih.
english_text: May all beings be happy, may all be free from illness. May all see what is auspicious, may no one suffer. Lead me from untruth to truth, from darkness to light, and from death to immortality. Om Peace, Peace, Peace.
benefits: Universal harmony and spiritual awakening

devanagari: शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशं विश्वाधारं गगनसदृशं मेघवर्णं शुभाङ्गम्। लक्ष्मीकान्तं कमलनयनं योगिभिर्ध्यानगम्यं वन्दे विष्णुं भवभयहरं सर्वलोकैकनाथम्॥ मङ्गलं भगवान् विष्णुर्मङ्गलं गरुडध्वजः।
phonetic: Shantakaram Bhujagashayanam Padmanabham Suresham, Vishvadharam Gaganasadrisham Meghavarnam Shubhangam. Lakshmikantam Kamalanayanam Yogibhir Dhyanagamyam, Vande Vishnum Bhavabhayaharam Sarvalokaikanatham. Mangalam Bhagavan Vishnur Mangalam Garudadhvajah.
english_text: I bow to Lord Vishnu, the embodiment of peace, who rests on the serpent bed, has a lotus springing from His navel, is the Lord of gods, the foundation of the universe, boundless like the sky, dark like a rain cloud, and beautiful. The beloved of Lakshmi, with lotus eyes, attainable by yogis in meditation, the destroyer of worldly fears, the supreme Lord of all worlds. All auspiciousness to Lord Vishnu.
benefits: Peace, mental stability, and divine protection

devanagari: सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ जयन्ती मङ्गला काली भद्रकाली कपालिनी। दुर्गा क्षमा शिवा धात्री स्वाहा स्वधा नमोऽस्तु ते॥
phonetic: Sarva Mangala Mangalye Shive Sarvartha Sadhike, Sharanye Tryambake Gauri Narayani Namostute. Jayanti Mangala Kali Bhadrakali Kapalini, Durga Kshama Shiva Dhatri Svaha Svadha Namostute.
english_text: Salutations to You, O Narayani, the most auspicious of all that is auspicious, the pure one who fulfills all objectives, the protector and three-eyed Gauri. Salutations to the conqueror, the auspicious Kali, Bhadrakali, the bearer of skulls, Durga, the forgiving, the benevolent, the supporter of the universe, and the receiver of sacred offerings.
benefits: Protection from adversity and auspiciousness

devanagari: मनोजवं मारुततुल्यवेगं जितेन्द्रियं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम्। वातात्मजं वानरयूथमुख्यं श्रीरामदूतं शरणं प्रपद्ये॥ बुद्धिर्बलं यशो धैर्यं निर्भयत्वमरोगता। अजाड्यं वाक्पटुत्वं च हनूमत्स्मरणाद्भवेत्॥
phonetic: Manojavam Marutatulyavegam Jitendriyam Buddhimatam Varishtham, Vatatmajam Vanarayuthamukhyam Shri Ramadutam Sharanam Prapadye. Buddhir Balam Yasho Dhairyam Nirbhayatvam Arogata, Ajadyam Vakpatutvam Cha Hanumat Smaranad Bhavet.
english_text: I take refuge in Lord Hanuman, the messenger of Sri Rama, whose mind is swift, who is as fast as the wind, who has conquered his senses, and is the foremost among the wise. By remembering Hanuman, one attains intelligence, physical strength, fame, courage, fearlessness, good health, freedom from laziness, and eloquence.
benefits: Courage, strength, and victory over fears

devanagari: वसुदेवसुतं देवं कंसचाणूरमर्दनम्। देवकीपरमानन्दं कृष्णं वन्दे जगद्गुरुम्॥ मूकं करोति वाचालं पङ्गुं लङ्घयते गिरिम्। यत्कृपा तमहं वन्दे परमानन्दमाधवम्॥
phonetic: Vasudeva Sutam Devam Kamsa Chanura Mardanam, Devaki Paramanandam Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum. Mukam Karoti Vachalam Pangum Langhayate Girim, Yatkripa Tamaham Vande Paramananda Madhavam.
english_text: I bow to Lord Krishna, the supreme teacher of the universe, the son of Vasudeva, the destroyer of the demons Kamsa and Chanura, and the greatest joy of mother Devaki. I bow to that supreme blissful Lord Madhava, whose grace makes the mute speak eloquently and the lame cross high mountains.
benefits: Joy, divine grace, and overcoming limitations

devanagari: रामाय रामभद्राय रामचन्द्राय वेधसे। रघुनाथाय नाथाय सीतायाः पतये नमः॥ आपदामपहर्तारं दातारं सर्वसम्पदाम्। लोकाभिरामं श्रीरामं भूयो भूयो नमाम्यहम्॥
phonetic: Ramaya Ramabhadraya Ramachandraya Vedhase, Raghunathaya Nathaya Sitayah Pataye Namaha. Aapadam Apahartaram Dataram Sarva Sampadam, Lokabhiramam Shri Ramam Bhuyo Bhuyo Namamyaham.
english_text: Salutations to Lord Rama, the auspicious one, the radiant moon, the creator, the lord of the Raghu dynasty, the protector, and the beloved husband of Sita. I repeatedly bow to Sri Rama, the most beautiful in the world, the destroyer of all distress, and the bestower of all wealth and prosperity.
benefits: Relief from distress and alignment with virtue

devanagari: कराग्रे वसते लक्ष्मीः करमध्ये सरस्वती। करमूले तु गोविन्दः प्रभाते करदर्शनम्॥ समुद्रवसने देवि पर्वतस्तनमण्डले। विष्णुपत्नि नमस्तुभ्यं पादस्पर्शं क्षमस्व मे॥
phonetic: Karagre Vasate Lakshmih Kara Madhye Saraswati, Karamule Tu Govindah Prabhate Karadarshanam. Samudra Vasane Devi Parvata Stana Mandale, Vishnu Patni Namastubhyam Pada Sparsham Kshamasva Me.
english_text: At the tip of my hands dwells Goddess Lakshmi, in the middle is Goddess Saraswati, and at the base rests Lord Govinda; therefore, I look at my hands every morning. O Mother Earth, who is clothed by the oceans and adorned with mountains, O consort of Lord Vishnu, I bow to You; please forgive me for stepping on You.
benefits: Purposeful mornings and gratitude towards nature

devanagari: नमस्तेऽस्तु महामाये श्रीपीठे सुरपूजिते। शङ्खचक्रगदाहस्ते महालक्ष्मि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ सर्वज्ञे सर्ववरदे सर्वदुष्टभयङ्करि। सर्वदुःखहरे देवि महालक्ष्मि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
phonetic: Namastestu Mahamaye Shri Pithe Sura Pujite, Shankha Chakra Gada Haste Mahalakshmi Namostute. Sarvajne Sarvavarade Sarvadushta Bhayankari, Sarvaduhkhahare Devi Mahalakshmi Namostute.
english_text: Salutations to You, O Supreme Illusion, seated on the auspicious lotus and worshipped by the gods. Holding the conch, discus, and mace, O Mahalakshmi, I bow to You. You are all-knowing, the bestower of all boons, a terror to all the wicked, and the remover of all sorrows. O Mahalakshmi, salutations to You.
benefits: Prosperity, abundance, and removal of sorrow

devanagari: कायेन वाचा मनसेन्द्रियैर्वा बुद्ध्यात्मना वा प्रकृतेः स्वभावात्। करोमि यद्यत्सकलं परस्मै नारायणायेति समर्पयामि॥ अच्युतं केशवं रामनारायणं कृष्णदामोदरं वासुदेवं हरिम्। श्रीधरं माधवं गोपिकावल्लभं जानकीनायकं रामचन्द्रं भजे॥
phonetic: Kayena Vacha Manasendriyairva Buddhyatmana Va Prakriteh Svabhavat, Karomi Yadyat Sakalam Parasmai Narayanayeti Samarpayami. Achyutam Keshavam Rama Narayanam Krishna Damodaram Vasudevam Harim, Shridharam Madhavam Gopikavallabham Janakinayakam Ramachandram Bhaje.
english_text: Whatever actions I perform with my body, speech, mind, senses, intellect, soul, or by my inherent nature, I dedicate them all to the Supreme Lord Narayana. I worship the infallible Lord Kesava, Narayana, Krishna, Damodara, Vasudeva, Hari, Shridhara, Madhava, the beloved of the Gopis, and Ramachandra, the Lord of Janaki.
benefits: Selfless devotion and surrender of ego

devanagari: ॐ भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवाः भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः। स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः॥ ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते। पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते॥
phonetic: Om Bhadram Karnebhih Shrinuyama Devah Bhadram Pashyemakshabhir Yajatrah, Sthirair Angais Tushtuvamsas Tanubhir Vyashema Devahitam Yadayuh. Om Purnamadah Purnamidam Purnat Purnam Udachyate, Purnasya Purnamadaya Purnamevavashishyate.
english_text: O Gods, may we hear with our ears what is auspicious, may we see with our eyes what is auspicious. Praising the divine with firm limbs and bodies, may we live the full lifespan allotted by the divine. That Supreme Reality is whole; this creation is whole. From the whole emerges the whole. When the whole is taken from the whole, the whole still remains.
benefits: Physical health, positivity, and spiritual completeness

devanagari: करचरणकृतं वाक् कायजं कर्मजं वा श्रवणनयनजं वा मानसंवापराधम्। विहितमविहितं वा सर्वमेतत् क्षमस्व जय जय करुणाब्धे श्रीमहादेव शम्भो॥ नागेन्द्रहाराय त्रिलोचनाय भस्माङ्गरागाय महेश्वराय। नित्याय शुद्धाय दिगम्बराय तस्मै नकाराय नमः शिवाय॥
phonetic: Kara Charana Kritam Vak Kayajam Karmajam Va Shravana Nayanajam Va Manasamvaparadham, Vihitam Avihitam Va Sarvam Etat Kshamasva Jaya Jaya Karunabdhe Shri Mahadeva Shambho. Nagendra Haraya Trilochanaya Bhasmanga Ragaya Maheshvaraya, Nityaya Shuddhaya Digambaraya Tasmai Nakaraya Namah Shivaya.
english_text: Please forgive all the wrongs I have committed with my hands, feet, speech, body, actions, ears, eyes, or mind. Forgive those deeds that were prohibited or neglected. Victory to You, O ocean of compassion, Lord Mahadeva Shambho. Salutations to Lord Shiva, wearing the serpent king as a garland, having three eyes, smeared with sacred ash, the eternal, pure, and naked deity.
benefits: Forgiveness, spiritual cleansing, and inner peace

devanagari: जपाकुसुमसंकाशं काश्यपेयं महाद्युतिम्। तमोऽरिं सर्वपापघ्नं प्रणतोऽस्मि दिवाकरम्॥ आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद मम भास्कर। दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते॥
phonetic: Japa Kusuma Sankasham Kashyapeyam Mahadyutim, Tamorim Sarva Papaghnam Pranato Asmi Divakaram. Aadi Deva Namastubhyam Prasida Mama Bhaskara, Divakara Namastubhyam Prabhakara Namostute.
english_text: I bow down to the Sun God, the maker of the day, who is bright as the red hibiscus flower, the son of Kashyapa, radiantly brilliant, the enemy of darkness, and the destroyer of all sins. Salutations to You, O primeval Lord, please be gracious to me, O Sun. Salutations to You, the creator of the day and the source of illumination.
benefits: Vitality, health, and dispelling of negativity

devanagari: अन्नपूर्णे सदापूर्णे शङ्करप्राणवल्लभे। ज्ञानवैराग्यसिद्ध्यर्थं भिक्षां देहि च पार्वति॥ माता मे पार्वती देवी पिता देवो महेश्वरः। बान्धवाः शिवभक्ताश्च स्वदेशो भुवनत्रयम्॥
phonetic: Annapurne Sada Purne Shankara Prana Vallabhe, Jnana Vairagya Siddhyartham Bhiksham Dehi Cha Parvati. Mata Me Parvati Devi Pita Devo Maheshvarah, Bandhavah Shiva Bhaktashcha Svadesho Bhuvana Trayam.
english_text: O Mother Annapurna, who is always full and complete, the beloved life-breath of Lord Shiva, O Goddess Parvati, grant me the alms of wisdom and detachment. Goddess Parvati is my mother, Lord Shiva is my father, the devotees of Shiva are my relatives, and all the three worlds are my homeland.
benefits: Nourishment, contentment, and detachment

devanagari: ब्रह्मा मुरारिस्त्रिपुरान्तकारी भानुः शशी भूमिसुतो बुधश्च। गुरुश्च शुक्रः शनिराहुकेतवः कुर्वन्तु सर्वे मम सुप्रभातम्॥ नमो सूर्याय चन्द्राय मङ्गलाय बुधाय च। गुरु शुक्र शनिभ्यश्च राहवे केतवे नमः॥
phonetic: Brahma Muraris Tripurantakari Bhanuh Shashi Bhumisuto Budhashcha, Gurushcha Shukrah Shani Rahu Ketavah Kurvantu Sarve Mama Suprabhatam. Namo Suryaya Chandraya Mangalaya Budhaya Cha, Guru Shukra Shanibhyashcha Rahave Ketave Namaha.
english_text: May Lord Brahma, Vishnu (Murari), and Shiva (destroyer of Tripura), along with the nine planets—Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, and Ketu—make my morning auspicious. Salutations to the Sun, Moon, Mars, and Mercury. Salutations also to Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, and Ketu.
benefits: Astrological harmony and smooth daily life

devanagari: षडाननं कुङ्कुमरक्तवर्णं महामतिं दिव्यमयूरवाहनम्। रुद्रस्य सूनुं सुरसैन्यनाथं गुहं सदाहं शरणं प्रपद्ये॥ मयूरारूढं मातोत्संगं त्रिलोचनम्। सुब्रह्मण्यं शिवसुतं प्रणमामि मुहुर्मुहुः॥
phonetic: Shadananam Kumkuma Raktavarnam Mahamatim Divya Mayura Vahanam, Rudrasya Sunum Surasainyanatham Guham Sadaham Sharanam Prapadye. Mayurarudham Matotsangam Trilochanam, Subrahmanyam Shivasutam Pranamami Muhurmuhuh.
english_text: I always take refuge in Lord Subrahmanya (Kartikeya), who has six faces, a complexion red as kumkuma, vast intelligence, rides a divine peacock, is the son of Lord Shiva, and the commander of the celestial army. I constantly bow to Subrahmanya, who rides a peacock, rests on His mother's lap, possesses three eyes, and is the valiant son of Shiva.
benefits: Confidence, martial strength, and victory in life

devanagari: गुरवे सर्वलोकानां भिषजे भवरोगिणाम्। निधये सर्वविद्यानां दक्षिणामूर्तये नमः॥ ॐ नमः प्रणवार्थाय शुद्धज्ञानैकमूर्तये। निर्मलाय प्रशान्ताय दक्षिणामूर्तये नमः॥
phonetic: Gurave Sarvalokanam Bhishaje Bhavaroginam, Nidhaye Sarvavidyanam Dakshinamurtaye Namaha. Om Namah Pranavarthaya Shuddha Jnanaika Murtaye, Nirmalaya Prashantaya Dakshinamurtaye Namaha.
english_text: Salutations to Lord Dakshinamurthy, the universal teacher, the supreme physician who cures the disease of worldly existence, and the ultimate treasure of all knowledge. Salutations to Him who is the meaning of the sacred Omkara, the very embodiment of pure knowledge, immaculate, infinitely peaceful, and facing the South.
benefits: Highest spiritual wisdom and mental tranquility

devanagari: उग्रं वीरं महाविष्णुं ज्वलन्तं सर्वतोमुखम्। नृसिंहं भीषणं भद्रं मृत्युमृत्युं नमाम्यहम्॥ नमस्ते नरसिंहाय प्रह्लादाह्लाददायिने। हिरण्यकशिपोर्वक्षः शिलाटङ्कनखालये॥
phonetic: Ugram Viram Mahavishnum Jvalantam Sarvatomukham, Nrisimham Bhishanam Bhadram Mrityumrityum Namamyaham. Namaste Narasimhaya Prahlada Hlada Dayine, Hiranyakashipor Vakshah Shila Tanka Nakhalaye.
english_text: I bow to Lord Narasimha, the ferocious and brave form of Maha Vishnu, who is blazing with heat, has faces in all directions, is terrifying yet highly auspicious, and is the very death of death itself. Salutations to Narasimha, who brings profound joy to Prahlada, and whose nails served as chisels on the stone-like chest of the demon Hiranyakashipu.
benefits: Ultimate protection and removal of severe fears

devanagari: ज्ञानानन्दमयं देवं निर्मलस्फटिकाकृतिम्। आधारं सर्वविद्यानां हयग्रीवमुपास्महे॥ ऋग्यजुस्सामरूपाय वेदाहरणकर्मणे। प्रणवोद्गीथवपुषे महाश्वशिरसे नमः॥
phonetic: Jnananandamayam Devam Nirmala Sphatikakrutim, Aadharam Sarvavidyanam Hayagrivam Upasmahe. Rig Yajus Sama Rupaya Vedaharana Karmane, Pranavodgitha Vapushe Mahashvashirase Namaha.
english_text: We meditate upon Lord Hayagriva, the embodiment of divine knowledge and bliss, possessing a form pure as a flawless crystal, the ultimate foundation of all knowledge. Salutations to Him who takes the form of the Rig, Yajur, and Sama Vedas, who recovered the stolen Vedas, whose body resonates with the sacred Om, and who bears the great head of a horse.
benefits: Exceptional intellect, focus, and mastery of arts

devanagari: नमामि धन्वन्तरिमादिदेवं सुरासुरैर्वन्दितपादपद्मम्। लोके जरामयभयमृत्युनाशं दातारमीशं विविधौषधीनाम्॥ शङ्खं चक्रं जलौकां दधदमृतघटं चारुदोर्भिचतुर्भिः। सूक्ष्मस्वच्छातिहृद्यांशुकपरिविलसन्मौलिमम्भोजनेत्रम्॥
phonetic: Namami Dhanvantarim Aadi Devam Sura Surair Vandita Pada Padmam, Loke Jaramaya Bhaya Mrityu Nasham Dataram Isham Vividhaushadhinam. Shankham Chakram Jalaukam Dadhadamrita Ghatam Charu Dorbhichaturbhih, Sukshma Svachchhati Hridyamshuka Parivilasan Maulimambhojanetram.
english_text: I bow to the primeval Lord Dhanvantari, whose lotus feet are worshipped by both gods and demons, who destroys old age, disease, fear, and death in the world, and who is the supreme bestower of all medicinal herbs. I meditate on Him who holds a conch, a discus, a leech, and a pot of nectar in His four beautiful hands, whose bright form shines with pure divine garments, and who has beautiful lotus eyes.
benefits: Healing, recovery from illness, and longevity

devanagari: यन्मूले सर्वतीर्थानि यन्मध्ये सर्वदेवताः। यदग्रे सर्ववेदाश्च तुलसीं तां नमाम्यहम्॥ वृन्दायै तुलसीदेव्यै प्रियायै केशवस्य च। विष्णुभक्तिप्रदे देवि सत्यवत्यै नमो नमः॥
phonetic: Yanmule Sarvatirthani Yanmadhye Sarvadevatah, Yadagre Sarvavedashcha Tulasim Tam Namamyaham. Vrindayai Tulasi Devyai Priyayai Keshavasya Cha, Vishnu Bhakti Prade Devi Satyavatyai Namo Namaha.
english_text: I bow down to the sacred Tulasi plant, at whose roots lie all the holy pilgrimages, in whose middle reside all the deities, and at whose top exist all the Vedas. Salutations to Goddess Tulasi, known as Vrinda, who is extremely dear to Lord Keshava (Vishnu). O bestower of devotion to Vishnu, embodiment of truth, repeated salutations to You.
benefits: Purity of home, devotion, and divine blessings

devanagari: लोकवीरं महापूज्यं सर्वरक्षाकरं विभुम्। पार्वतीहृदयानन्दं शास्तारं प्रणमाम्यहम्॥ विप्रपूज्यं विश्ववन्द्यं विष्णुशम्भोः प्रियं सुतम्। क्षिप्रप्रसादनिरतं शास्तारं प्रणमाम्यहम्॥
phonetic: Loka Veeram Mahapoojyam Sarva Rakshakaram Vibhum, Parvati Hridayanandam Shastaram Pranamamyaham. Vipra Poojyam Vishva Vandyam Vishnu Shambhoh Priyam Sutam, Kshipra Prasada Niratam Shastaram Pranamamyaham.
english_text: I bow to Lord Ayyappa (Shasta), the hero of the world, highly revered, the protector of all, the all-pervading lord, and the joy of Mother Parvati's heart. I bow to Lord Shasta, worshipped by the wise, revered by the universe, the beloved son of Vishnu and Shiva, who is always swift to bestow His grace and blessings.
benefits: Discipline, protection during travel, and spiritual fortitude

devanagari: दत्तात्रेयं हरिं कृष्णं उन्मत्तानन्ददायकम्। दिगम्बरं मुनिं बालं पिशाचज्ञानसागरम्॥ जटाधरं पाण्डुराङ्गं शूलहस्तं कृपानिधिम्। सर्वरोगहरं देवं दत्तात्रेयमहं भजे॥
phonetic: Dattatreyam Harim Krishnam Unmattananda Dayakam, Digambaram Munim Balam Pishacha Jnana Sagaram. Jatadharam Pandurangam Shula Hastam Kripanidhim, Sarvaroga Haram Devam Dattatreyam Aham Bhaje.
english_text: I worship Lord Dattatreya, who is Hari and Krishna, the giver of ecstatic spiritual bliss, the sky-clad sage, possessing child-like innocence, who acts mysteriously yet is an ocean of supreme knowledge. I adore Dattatreya, bearing matted hair, fair in complexion, holding a trident, an absolute treasure of mercy, and the divine destroyer of all diseases.
benefits: Guidance from the supreme Guru, freedom from illusions

devanagari: कल्याणाद्भुतगात्राय कामितार्थप्रदायिने। श्रीमद्वेङ्कटनाथाय श्रीनिवासाय ते नमः॥ श्रियः कान्ताय कल्याणनिधये निधयेऽर्थिनाम्। श्रीवेङ्कटनिवासाय श्रीनिवासाय मङ्गलम्॥
phonetic: Kalyanadbhuta Gatraya Kamitartha Pradayine, Shrimad Venkatanathaya Shrinivasaya Te Namaha. Shriyah Kantaya Kalyana Nidhaye Nidhaye Arthinam, Shri Venkata Nivasaya Shrinivasaya Mangalam.
english_text: Salutations to Lord Venkatanatha, whose body is wonderfully auspicious and beautiful, and who effortlessly grants all the desired wishes of His devotees. May all auspiciousness be unto Srinivasa, the beloved Lord of Goddess Lakshmi, the eternal treasure of all goodness, the ultimate refuge for seekers, who eternally resides on the Venkata hills.
benefits: Fulfillment of righteous desires and prosperity

devanagari: श्रीरङ्गनाथ किमपि स्पृहयामि नाद्य त्वत्पादपङ्कजयुगप्रणमादृतेऽहम्। त्वत्कीर्तनं त्वदनुचिन्तनमच्युतेति त्वन्नामकीर्तनमशेषमुदे ममास्तु॥ कवेरकन्याकमनीयतीरे विश्राम्यमानं नवरङ्गपीठे। श्रीरङ्गनाथं शयनोत्सवाढ्यं श्रीरङ्गनाथं शिरसा नमामि॥
phonetic: Shriranganatha Kimapi Sprihayami Nadya Tvat Pada Pankaja Yuga Pranamadrite Aham. Tvat Kirtanam Tvad Anuchintanam Achyuteti Tvan Nama Kirtanam Ashesha Mude Mamastu. Kavera Kanya Kamaniya Tire Vishramyamanam Nava Ranga Pithe, Shri Ranganatham Shayanotsavadhyam Shri Ranganatham Shirasa Namami.
english_text: O Lord Ranganatha, I desire nothing else today except to bow completely at Your lotus feet. May singing Your glories, constantly thinking of You, and chanting Your name 'Achyuta' become the endless source of my joy. I bow my head to Lord Ranganatha, who rests beautifully upon the divine stage along the lovely banks of the river Kaveri.
benefits: Deep spiritual devotion and inner tranquility

devanagari: महायोगपीठे तटे भीमरथ्या वरं पुण्डरीकाय दातुं मुनीन्द्रैः। समागत्य तिष्ठन्तमानन्दकन्दं परब्रह्मलिङ्गं भजे पाण्डुरङ्गम्॥ तडिद्वाससं नव्यमेघावभासं स्फुरन्कौस्तुभोद्भासितं श्रीनिकेतम्। परब्रह्मलिङ्गं भजे पाण्डुरङ्गम्॥
phonetic: Maha Yoga Pithe Tate Bhimarathya Varam Pundarikaya Datum Munindrai, Samagatya Tishthantam Ananda Kandam Parabrahma Lingam Bhaje Pandurangam. Tadid Vasasam Navya Meghavabhasam Sphuran Kaustubhod Bhasitam Shri Niketam, Parabrahma Lingam Bhaje Pandurangam.
english_text: I worship Panduranga, the supreme form of Brahman, who stands on the great seat of yoga along the banks of the Bhima river, surrounded by great sages, waiting to bless His devotee Pundarika. I adore Panduranga, who wears garments brilliant as lightning, possesses a complexion like a fresh raincloud, and shines radiantly with the Kaustubha gem.
benefits: Divine love, patience, and devotion to parents

devanagari: नागेन्द्रहाराय त्रिलोचनाय भस्माङ्गरागाय महेश्वराय। नित्याय शुद्धाय दिगम्बराय तस्मै नकाराय नमः शिवाय॥ मन्दाकिनीसलिलचन्दनचर्चिताय नन्दीश्वरप्रमथनाथमहेश्वराय। मन्दारपुष्पबहुपुष्पसुपूजिताय तस्मै मकाराय नमः शिवाय॥
phonetic: Nagendra Haraya Trilochanaya Bhasmanga Ragaya Maheshvaraya, Nityaya Shuddhaya Digambaraya Tasmai Nakaraya Namah Shivaya. Mandakini Salila Chandana Charchitaya Nandishvara Pramatha Natha Maheshvaraya, Mandara Pushpa Bahu Pushpa Supujitaya Tasmai Makaraya Namah Shivaya.
english_text: Salutations to the syllable 'Na' of Lord Shiva, who wears the serpent king as a garland, has three eyes, is smeared with sacred ash, and is the pure eternal Lord. Salutations to the syllable 'Ma', who is bathed in the waters of the Ganges, anointed with sandal paste, the lord of Nandi and the divine hosts, and worshipped with beautiful Mandara flowers.
benefits: Purification of the mind and deep meditation

devanagari: ब्रह्ममुरारिसुरार्चितलिङ्गं निर्मलभासितशोभितलिङ्गम्। जन्मजदुःखविनाशकलिङ्गं तत्प्रणमामि सदाशिवलिङ्गम्॥ देवमुनिप्रवरार्चितलिङ्गं कामदहं करुणाकरलिङ्गम्। रावणदर्पविनाशनलिङ्गं तत्प्रणमामि सदाशिवलिङ्गम्॥
phonetic: Brahma Murari Surarchita Lingam Nirmala Bhasita Shobhita Lingam, Janmaja Duhkha Vinashaka Lingam Tat Pranamami Sadashiva Lingam. Deva Muni Pravararchita Lingam Kamadaham Karunakara Lingam, Ravana Darpa Vinashana Lingam Tat Pranamami Sadashiva Lingam.
english_text: I bow before that Sadashiva Linga, which is worshipped by Brahma, Vishnu, and the gods, which is pure, beautifully radiant, and destroys the sorrows associated with the cycle of birth. I bow before that Sadashiva Linga, worshipped by great sages, which burnt the god of desire, is the embodiment of compassion, and destroyed the immense pride of Ravana.
benefits: Destruction of ego and freedom from worldly sorrow

devanagari: त्रिदलं त्रिगुणाकारं त्रिनेत्रं च त्रियायुधम्। त्रिजन्मपापसंहारं एकबिल्वं शिवार्पणम्॥ शालिग्रामशिलमेकां विप्राणां जातु चार्पयेत्। सोमयज्ञमहापुण्यं एकबिल्वं शिवार्पणम्॥
phonetic: Tridalam Trigunakaram Trinetram Cha Triyayudham, Trijanma Papa Samharam Eka Bilvam Shivarpanam. Shaligrama Shilamekam Vipranam Jatu Charpayet, Soma Yajna Maha Punyam Eka Bilvam Shivarpanam.
english_text: I offer to Lord Shiva a single Bilva leaf, which has three distinct leaves representing the three qualities (gunas), Lord Shiva's three eyes, and His three weapons; offering just one leaf destroys the sins of three lifetimes. Offering a single Bilva leaf to Lord Shiva generates the immense spiritual merit equivalent to gifting a sacred Shaligrama stone or performing the great Soma sacrifice.
benefits: Clearing of karmic debts and divine grace

devanagari: न तातो न माता न बन्धुर्न दाता न पुत्रो न पुत्री न भृत्यो न भर्ता। न जाया न विद्या न वृत्तिर्ममैव गतिस्त्वं गतिस्त्वं त्वमेका भवानि॥ भवाब्धावपारे महादुःखभीरुः पपात प्रकामी प्रलोभी प्रमत्तः। कुसंसारपाशप्रबद्धः सदाहं गतिस्त्वं गतिस्त्वं त्वमेका भवानि॥
phonetic: Na Tato Na Mata Na Bandhur Na Data Na Putro Na Putri Na Bhrityo Na Bharta. Na Jaya Na Vidya Na Vrittir Mamaiva Gatistvam Gatistvam Tvameka Bhavani. Bhavabdhav Apare Maha Duhkha Bhiruh Papata Prakami Pralobhi Pramattah, Kusamsara Pasha Prabaddhah Sadaham Gatistvam Gatistvam Tvameka Bhavani.
english_text: Neither father, nor mother, nor relative, nor donor; neither son, nor daughter, nor servant, nor husband; neither wife, nor knowledge, nor my profession is my true refuge. You alone are my refuge, O Mother Bhavani. I am drowning in this boundless ocean of worldly existence, filled with desires, greed, and fear; bound by the chains of this world. You alone are my ultimate refuge, O Mother.
benefits: Surrender during difficult times and emotional security

devanagari: अयि गिरिनन्दिनि नन्दितमेदिनि विश्वविनोदिनि नन्दिनुते। गिरिवरविन्ध्यशिरोऽधिनिवासिनि विष्णुविलासिनि जिष्णुनुते॥ भगवति हे शितिकण्ठकुटुम्बिनि भूरिकुटुम्बिनि भूरिकृते। जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते॥
phonetic: Ayi Giri Nandini Nandita Medini Vishva Vinodini Nandinute, Girivara Vindhya Shirodhinivasini Vishnu Vilasini Jishnunute. Bhagavati He Shitikantha Kutumbini Bhuri Kutumbini Bhuri Krite, Jaya Jaya He Mahishasura Mardini Ramya Kapardini Shailasute.
english_text: O daughter of the mountain, who fills the earth with joy, who delights the universe, and is praised by Nandi; who resides on the peak of the great Vindhya mountains, bringing joy to Vishnu, praised by the victorious. O Goddess, consort of Lord Shiva, who holds the universe as Her vast family; victory, victory to You, the destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, with beautifully braided hair, O daughter of the mountain.
benefits: Invincible strength, courage, and triumph over evil

devanagari: देवि सुरेश्वरि भगवति गङ्गे त्रिभुवनतारिणि तरलतरङ्गे। शङ्करमौलिविहारिणि विमले मम मतिरास्तां तव पदकमले॥ भागीरथि सुखदायिनि मातस्तव जलमहिमा निगमे ख्यातः। नाहं जाने तव महिमानं पाहि कृपामयि मामज्ञानम्॥
phonetic: Devi Sureshwari Bhagavati Gange Tribhuvana Tarini Tarala Tarange, Shankara Mauli Viharini Vimale Mama Matir Astam Tava Pada Kamale. Bhagirathi Sukhadayini Matas Tava Jala Mahima Nigame Khyatah, Naham Jane Tava Mahimanam Pahi Kripamayi Mam Ajnanam.
english_text: O Goddess Ganga, Lord of the Gods, savior of the three worlds with your rapid waves! O pure one who wanders elegantly in the matted locks of Lord Shiva, may my mind always remain fixed at your lotus feet. O Mother Bhagirathi, giver of happiness, the glory of your sacred waters is sung in the Vedas. I do not fully comprehend your immense greatness; O compassionate Mother, please protect this ignorant child.
benefits: Purification of the soul and peace of mind

devanagari: रश्मिमन्तं समुद्यन्तं देवासुरनमस्कृतम्। पूजयस्व विवस्वन्तं भास्करं भुवनेश्वरम्॥ सर्वदेवात्मको ह्येष तेजस्वी रश्मिभावनः। एष देवासुरगणाँल्लोकान् पाति गभस्तिभिः॥
phonetic: Rashmimantam Samudyantam Devasura Namaskritam, Pujayasva Vivasvantam Bhaskaram Bhuvaneshvaram. Sarva Devatmako Hyesha Tejasvi Rashmibhavanah, Esha Devasura Ganan Lokan Pati Gabhastibhih.
english_text: Worship the Sun God (Surya), who is crowned with rays, rising gloriously, and revered by both deities and demons; the brilliant creator of light, the lord of the universe. He is the very soul of all the gods, inherently radiant, and the creator of all light rays. With His brilliant rays, He unconditionally nourishes and protects all beings, deities, demons, and the worlds.
benefits: Victory over challenges, radiant health, and leadership

devanagari: ॐ हिरण्यवर्णां हरिणीं सुवर्णरजतस्रजाम्। चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह॥ तां म आवह जातवेदो लक्ष्मीमनपगामिनीम्। यस्यां हिरण्यं विन्देयं गामश्वं पुरुषानहम्॥
phonetic: Om Hiranya Varnam Harinim Suvarna Rajata Srajam, Chandram Hiranmayim Lakshmim Jatavedo Ma Avaha. Tam Ma Avaha Jatavedo Lakshmim Anapagaminim, Yasyam Hiranyam Vindeyam Gamasvam Purushan Aham.
english_text: O Agni (Jataveda), invoke for me that Goddess Lakshmi, who is of a golden color, beautifully radiant like a deer, adorned with garlands of silver and gold, glowing like the moon, and made of gold. O Agni, please invoke for me that Goddess Lakshmi who never leaves, by whose grace I will obtain abundant gold, cattle, horses, and well-wishers.
benefits: Continuous wealth, magnetism, and material stability

devanagari: ॐ सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्। स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वा अत्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम्॥ पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यम्। उतामृतत्वस्येशानो यदन्नेनातिरोहति॥
phonetic: Om Sahasra Shirsha Purushah Sahasrakshah Sahasra Pat, Sa Bhumim Vishvato Vritva Atyatishthad Dashangulam. Purusha Evedam Sarvam Yad Bhutam Yachcha Bhavyam, Utamritatvasyeshano Yad Annenatirohati.
english_text: The Supreme Being (Purusha) has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, and a thousand feet. Enveloping the entire earth from all sides, He transcends it by ten fingers' breadth. This Purusha is indeed all this universe—whatever was in the past, and whatever will be in the future. He is the sovereign lord of immortality, manifesting in a form that grows through physical food.
benefits: Cosmic awareness, detachment, and supreme peace

devanagari: त्वमेव माता च पिता त्वमेव त्वमेव बन्धुश्च सखा त्वमेव। त्वमेव विद्या द्रविणं त्वमेव त्वमेव सर्वं मम देव देव॥ पापोहं पापकर्माहं पापात्मा पापसम्भवः। त्राहि मां कृपया देव शरणागतवत्सल॥
phonetic: Tvameva Mata Cha Pita Tvameva Tvameva Bandhushcha Sakha Tvameva, Tvameva Vidya Dravinam Tvameva Tvameva Sarvam Mama Deva Deva. Papoham Papakarmaham Papatma Papasambhavah, Trahi Mam Kripaya Deva Sharanagatavatsala.
english_text: O Supreme Lord, You are my mother, my father, my relative, and my dearest friend. You alone are my supreme knowledge and my wealth; You are everything to me, O God of Gods. I am prone to errors, my actions are flawed, my mind is susceptible to wrongdoing, and I am born of imperfections. O compassionate Lord who loves those who surrender, please graciously save me.
benefits: Complete surrender, comfort in distress, and divine grace
